# The commands behind the video (generated by make video-assets; do not edit)

One section per on-screen moment of `docs/video-script.md`: the time, the command to type, the lines
to freeze on exactly as they were printed here, then the whole observed output. Run on the scripted
model and the fixtures in the dispatch sandbox; every number is the fixture run's until the laptop
reruns it (`docs/SUNDAY.md`), and the live-model shot is never simulated.

## The first shot: the whole run in plain lines (what code decided, what the model tried, what stopped it)

At 1:20 to 2:45 in the script. Command:

```
$ make demo-one-brief
```

Open on this; the trace shot (below) is the same run as the SDK saw it.

Freeze on:

```

  what stopped it: the hook cancelled it before the tool ran

  what stopped it: the steering gate after the model threw the plan away

## The rider's own words: read by the model into a fixed vocabulary, applied by code as feasibility

At 2:45 to 3:30 in the script. Command:

```
$ make demo-one-brief DEMO_ONE_ARGS='--note "No ramps today, I am pushing a stroller"'
```

The alternate elevator's route uses a ramp, so it is out for this rider today; BART's next option, with the policy engine's minutes. The note can only take options away, never add, reorder or number them.

Freeze on:

```
the rider wrote: "No ramps today, I am pushing a stroller"; read as: no ramps (model); code applied it as feasibility only, BART's order among the rest stands
code decided: DELN elevator DELN-E1 is out at your starting station; BART's option, in BART's order: the transit connection BART lists, about 20 minutes more
```

Observed output:

```

the model tried (1): draft_plan with elevator='FAKE-E7', option='transit', station='DELN'
  what stopped it: the hook cancelled it before the tool ran
the model tried (2): draft_plan with elevator='DELN-E1', option='alternate_elevator', station='DELN'
  what stopped it: the steering gate before the tool sent it back with BART's order
the model tried (3): Plan with added_minutes=1, elevator='DELN-E1', option='alternate_elevator', station='DELN'
  what stopped it: the steering gate after the model threw the plan away
what reached the rider: transit at DELN (DELN-E1), 20 minutes more, in a sentence code composed from BART's wording:
